description: A vulnerability has been found in liuwy-project zhglxt up to 3fd4ad44458f87bdad0afa997ba29706488fa1ff. This issue affects the function markdownUploadFile of the file zhglxt-web/src/main/java/com/zhglxt/web/controller/common/CommonController.java. The manipulation of the argument editormd-image-file leads to unrestricted upload. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. This product is using a rolling release to provide continious delivery. Therefore, no version details for affected nor updated releases are available.
